description: Universal document critique and expert proofreading with adaptive personas. Analyzes any text (emails, proposals, technical docs, prompts, articles) with weighted criteria scoring, visual radar, confidence indicators, and structured feedback. Features 4 personas (Mentor, Editor, Devil's Advocate, Target Reader) with auto-switch. Supports 5 modes: standard, express, focus, compare, checklist. Use when user says "critique", "analyze", "proofread", "review", "evaluate". Not for simple spell-check, content creation, or image evaluation.
